decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The following dimensions shall be strictly followed
    16 metres.
    when the building is constructed:
    (a) maximum height of Eversholt Street elevation
    from the pavement: 22 metres (excluding lift shaft);
    (b) Maximum height of the Grafton Place elevation
    from the pavement: 12.3 metres and of the rear elevation
    from the same pavement: 10.7 metres;
    (c) Minimum distance between Wellesley House and the
    development along Grafton Place, above ground floor level:

Condition : 2 - The details of the [layout, sections, elevations and facing materials] to be used on the building shall not be otherwise than as shall have been submitted to and approved by the Council before any work is commenced on the relevant part of the development. [Such details shall include proposed slab levels of the building in relation to the existing and proposed levels of the site and the surrounding land.] These parts of the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1 and EN13 [and EN31 if in a CA] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not begin until full details of the scheme for the ventilation of and the extraction of fumes from the premises to an adequate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant have been submitted to and approved by the Council and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the [adjoining] premises [and the area generally] in accordance with the requirements of policy[ies] RE2[, EN5, EN6, DS6 (and SH18 if A3 use)] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 4 - Details of the windows on the proposed north-east
    elevations, which shall show how unreasonable overlooking of
    neighbouring premises can be avoided, shall be submitted to
    and approved by the Council before works commence on site.

Condition : 5 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.

Condition : 6 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the
    area generally.

Condition : 7 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and
    protect residents of Wellesley House from overlooking.

Condition : 8 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and
    protect residents of Wellesley House from overlooking.
description:
Amendment to the planning permission granted on 2 April 1996
(PL9400416/R3) for the redevelopment of the site by erection
of a hotel with restaurant and conference facilities
involving new elevational treatment new servicing
arrangements and increasing the number of rooms from 77 to
165,
as shown on drawing numbers CHO1/401, /402B, /403 to /411,
/412A, /413 to /416, /419, /422 and /423.
